tasks.label: GERALDO: simulação
tasks.command: source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && source robot/ros2_ws/install/setup.bash && ros2 launch geraldo_description sim.launch.py

tasks.label: GERALDO: Nav2
tasks.command: source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && source robot/ros2_ws/install/setup.bash && bash robot/scripts/wait_for.sh "timeout 5 ros2 topic echo --once /scan" 120 && ros2 launch geraldo_nav nav.launch.py

tasks.label: GERALDO: varredura dos 10 pontos
tasks.command: source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && source robot/ros2_ws/install/setup.bash && bash robot/scripts/wait_for.sh "ros2 lifecycle get /amcl | grep -q active && ros2 lifecycle get /bt_navigator | grep -q active" 180 && sleep 5 && python3 robot/scripts/nav_goal_sweep.py
